camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeAccesskeyLeakList --region cn-hangzhou --Status pending --StartTs 1614155361489 --Query yourAccessKeyID --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 12324284232340000
description_en: Queries information about leaked AccessKey pairs in your assets
description_zh: 查询您资产中已泄露的AccessKey信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-accesskey-leak-list --status pending --query yourAccessKeyID --start-ts 1614155361489 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccesskeyLeakList

parameters.help_en:
The processing status of the leaked AccessKey information that you want to query. Valid values:
pending: unprocessed
dealed: processed
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的已泄露的AccessKey信息的处理状态。取值：
pending：未处理
dealed：已处理
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的AccessKey ID。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The discovery time of the leaked information that you want to query. All AccessKey leak information discovered after this point in time is returned. This parameter is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的泄露信息的发现时间，可以查询该时间点后发现的所有AccessKey泄露信息。该参数为时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_ts

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. The maximum value of PageSize is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id
